missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics for the 503 window
candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations across all sampled checkout traces; order then fails with 502 and gateway checkout returns 502. The bounded fault is a server-side error originating in the payment dependency, not gateway latency (durations 47-94ms).
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side logs or metrics admitted; exact internal cause of the 503 (crash, saturation, config) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout correlation failing at payment POST /v1/authorizations with 503, propagating as order 502 and gateway checkout 502; inventory/redis calls succeed. Gateway metrics show 502s on /v1/checkout with low p95 latency (~94ms), ruling out gateway latency. Topology confirms gateway->order->payment path. Root cause bounded to payment server error; internal mechanism unconfirmed.
